skills.name: IFC Quantity Takeoff
skills.description: Extract quantities (volume, area, count) from an IFC model and produce a structured takeoff table for cost estimation.
when_to_use: You have an IFC export and need a quantity table without opening authoring software.
Early cost estimating where speed matters more than a certified takeoff.
inputs: An IFC file (IFC2x3 or IFC4) or a link to one
Optional: which element classes to count
outputs: A structured table: element class, count, area, volume
Notes on elements skipped or ambiguous

example_io.in: Take off concrete volume and formwork area from this structural IFC.
example_io.out: IfcBeam ×42 (18.6 m³), IfcColumn ×28 (11.2 m³), IfcSlab ×6 (94.0 m³); formwork area 612 m² — 3 elements skipped (no geometry).

skills.name: Building Code & Standards Lookup
skills.description: Answer code questions (IBC, ASCE 7, ACI) with section-level citations so an engineer can verify the source instead of trusting a paraphrase.
when_to_use: An engineer needs the governing code clause and wants to verify the source, not trust a paraphrase.
Drafting a design narrative that must cite IBC / ASCE 7 / ACI sections.
outputs: A direct answer with the exact section number quoted
A 'verify here' pointer so the human checks the primary source

example_io.in: What is the minimum roof live load for an ordinary flat roof under ASCE 7?
example_io.out: ASCE 7-22 §4.8.2: minimum roof live load Lr = 20 psf, reducible per §4.8.2 down to 12 psf based on tributary area and slope. Verify against your adopted edition.

skills.name: Material Spec Drafting (CSI MasterFormat)
skills.description: Draft a Division-03/04 material specification section in CSI MasterFormat from a short product description, with placeholders flagged for review.
when_to_use: You need a first-draft spec section in CSI MasterFormat from a short product note.
Standardizing material specs across a project for later editor review.
outputs: Placeholders flagged [REVIEW] where project data is missing

example_io.in: Draft a spec for cast-in-place structural concrete, 4000 psi, normal weight.
example_io.out: 03 30 00 Cast-in-Place Concrete — Part 2 Products: f'c = 4000 psi @ 28 days, [REVIEW slump], normal-weight aggregate per ASTM C33 …

skills.name: Site Photo Safety Audit (PPE)
skills.description: Review a construction site photo and report missing PPE (hardhat, vest, harness) with an OSHA-aligned checklist and confidence notes.
related_resources: CHV: Color Helmet and Vest Dataset
when_to_use: A safety lead wants a quick PPE check on daily site photos.
Triaging a backlog of progress photos for obvious hazards before a walk-through.
inputs: Optional: which PPE items are required on this site
outputs: Confidence notes and a 'needs human review' flag for low-confidence calls

example_io.in: Check this photo of two workers near an excavation for missing PPE.
example_io.out: Worker A: hardhat ✓, hi-vis ✓, harness n/a. Worker B: hardhat ✗ (likely missing), hi-vis ✓. Low confidence on B — verify; near open edge, consider fall-protection review.

skills.name: Schedule Analysis (Last Planner System)
skills.description: Analyze a weekly work plan against Last Planner System principles, compute PPC (Percent Plan Complete), and surface root causes of variance.
when_to_use: A superintendent wants PPC computed and variance reasons categorized from a weekly plan.
Coaching a team on Last Planner System discipline using their own data.
inputs: A weekly work plan (committed vs completed tasks)
Optional: reasons logged for incomplete tasks
outputs: PPC (Percent Plan Complete) for the week
Root-cause breakdown of variances (prerequisites, resources, weather, design)

example_io.in: Here are 12 committed tasks; 9 done. Compute PPC and group the misses.
example_io.out: PPC = 75% (9/12). Misses: 2× missing prerequisite work, 1× material late. Recommend tightening make-ready look-ahead for prerequisites.

skills.name: Scan-to-BIM QA/QC Helper
skills.description: Compare an as-built point cloud against a design BIM and report deviations beyond tolerance, grouped by building element.
when_to_use: You have an as-built point cloud and a design BIM and need a deviation report.
QA/QC before handover, to flag elements out of tolerance by trade.
inputs: A registered point cloud (E57/LAS) or link
outputs: Deviation report grouped by building element
Elements exceeding tolerance, with magnitude and direction

example_io.in: Compare this as-built scan to the design model at ±15 mm tolerance.
example_io.out: Walls: 3 panels +22 mm (out of tol). Slabs: within tol. MEP risers: 1 segment offset 40 mm — flag for RFI. Overall 92% of elements within tolerance.

skills.name: Energy Model Brief Generator
skills.description: Turn a project brief into a starting EnergyPlus/IDF parameter set and a checklist of assumptions for a building energy analysis.
when_to_use: You want a starting EnergyPlus parameter set from a conceptual project brief.
Listing the assumptions an energy model will rest on, for early review.
inputs: A project brief (use, location, area, envelope notes)
outputs: A starter IDF parameter set (zones, loads, schedules)
A checklist of assumptions flagged for an engineer to confirm

example_io.in: Mid-size office, 3 floors, temperate climate — give me a starting energy model brief.
example_io.out: 3 thermal zones/floor, LPD 8 W/m² [confirm], occupancy 0.05 ppl/m², ASHRAE office schedule, U-wall 0.35 [confirm climate zone]. 6 assumptions flagged.

skills.name: RFI & Submittal Drafter
skills.description: Draft a clear RFI or submittal-review response from field notes, with references to the relevant drawing/spec section and a suggested disposition.
when_to_use: Field notes need to become a clear RFI or submittal-review response fast.
Keeping RFIs consistent with references to the relevant drawing/spec section.
outputs: A drafted RFI or submittal response
Suggested disposition and the spec/drawing section to cite

example_io.in: Beam pocket on grid C-4 doesn't match the column. Draft an RFI.
example_io.out: RFI: 'Conflict at grid C-4 — beam pocket elevation per S-301 detail 4 conflicts with column per S-201. Please confirm governing detail.' Ref: S-301/4, S-201. Suggested disposition: clarify, no cost impact pending response.
